expression-portrait.png

NASA public-domain photograph of Eileen Collins, distributed as the
scikit-image astronaut sample. Used only as simulated camera input in tests.
This test fixture is not included in the production build.

Source file:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png
Source documentation and public-domain attribution:
https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut

The tests check that a real model can detect a face and select a prompt.
They do not assert the photographed person's actual emotional state, and
do not establish accuracy across people, expressions or lighting conditions.
